inference.method: paired t over trajectory seeds; Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided CIs and Holm one-sided p-values within each family

predictions.H1: Whole-curve test reuse is positive in each of the two tasks (simultaneous lower CI > 0).
predictions.H2: Early outcome-luck contrast is positive and early-minus-late contrast is positive in each task (four simultaneous lower CIs > 0).
predictions.H3: In each task all three strategies are materially short of oracle-test, while at least one strategy is certified not materially short of oracle-exante (its simultaneous upper CI <= 0.0005). Mere failure to reject a shortfall does NOT satisfy the second clause.

stopping: Fixed 12 seeds per task; no interim endpoint inspection or seed expansion; failures retained. Development uses only 99001; synthetic timing only 99003.
scope: Frozen pretrained deep encoders plus retrained nonlinear 32-hidden-unit ReLU head; not end-to-end backbone fine-tuning.
Binary subsets of CIFAR-10 and AG News; not full multiclass benchmark reproduction.
V13 pool/batch/steps/R retained; evaluation split sizes, 12 seeds, baseline set and neural learner are external adaptations.
Outcome-luck contrast is conditional on an estimated GBDT outcome model and on greedy search; not a population irreducibility certificate.
Own-trajectory contrasts include downstream trajectory changes; significance changes do not establish equivalence.
search: Greedy search picks exactly 10. Each lookahead fit retrains the same nonlinear head for 60 full-batch Adam steps; common seed and initialization across all fits. Ex-ante sees only synthetic candidate labels; actual labels revealed after selection.
preprocessing: Official test set only used for intentional oracle-test selection and shared scoring. Other roles drawn disjointly from official train per seed. PCA/whitening fitted only to auxiliary features. GBDT uses only auxiliary labels. Text exact dedup across official splits before embedding.
